labor_unit_note: Workbook does not state whether hours are worker-, crew-, or elapsed hours. Treated as effort; elapsed-time conversion exposes its assumed crew size. Open question for AEP mentors.
labor_caveats: Apply the ILM once to summed DIRECT hours. Do NOT separately add travel/setup/safety — the ILM already accounts for them (avoids double counting).
'Labor only work' adders are DIRECT-hour adders (e.g. Restricted Access 0.5 h) and are added to direct hours BEFORE applying the ILM.
Values are averages across construction units; individual jobs vary. Treat as planning estimates.
Excavation adders are per cubic foot and require a volume not present in the storm data.

damage_scenarios.description: Storm passed without equipment damage on this premise's path.

damage_scenarios.label: Single fuse operation
damage_scenarios.description: A protective fuse opened; one refuse restores service once reached.

damage_scenarios.label: Downed pole + conductor
damage_scenarios.description: A pole is down, taking a primary span with it. The span can only be re-hung after the pole is set (dependency).

damage_scenarios.label: Widespread damage
damage_scenarios.description: Multiple poles and spans down plus a failed transformer. Pole/span pairs are dependent; transformer work is independent and parallelizable.
